title: Green Chile Chicken Stew
seoTitle: Green Chile Chicken Stew | Firefighter Meal
shortDescription: Tomatillo and green chile stew with white beans for ten
subtitle: Tomatillo and green chile stew with white beans for ten
description: Chicken thighs braise with tomatillos, green chiles, and white beans until tender and tangy. Cumin and cilantro finish the pot for a bright, warming stew that is not standard chili.

steps.title: Char the tomatillos
steps.instruction: Broil tomatillos and onion at 500°F 5–7 minutes until blistered. Blend with green chiles and half the garlic until smooth. Target oven/smoker temperature: 500°F.

steps.title: Sear the chicken
steps.instruction: Season chicken thighs and sear in oil 4 minutes per side until golden. Set aside.

steps.title: Simmer the stew
steps.instruction: Sauté remaining garlic and cumin 1 minute. Add tomatillo puree and broth. Return chicken and simmer 30 minutes until internal temp reaches 165°F. Target oven/smoker temperature: 165°F.

steps.title: Shred and finish
steps.instruction: Remove chicken, shred meat, discard bones. Return meat to pot with beans and simmer 10 minutes. Stir in half the cilantro.

steps.title: Serve with garnishes
steps.instruction: Ladle into bowls and top with remaining cilantro and lime wedges. Offer hot sauce at the line.

proTips: Roasted poblano peppers diced in add smoky depth beyond canned chiles.
Corn kernels stirred in at the end make this feel like a complete bowl.
This thickens overnight—thin reheats with broth, not water.
tonightSpread: Stew with warm flour tortillas for dunking.
Shredded Monterey Jack and sour cream at the line.
leftovers: Layer over rice with fried egg for a green chile bowl breakfast.
Use as enchilada filling with extra cheese and sauce.
whyCrewsLikeIt: Green chile stew feels different from the usual tomato chili rotation. It is hearty, tangy, and the heat level is easy to control for mixed spice tolerances on the crew.
mealPrepNotes: Roast fresh tomatillos under broiler for depth if using raw. Canned green chiles work fine for speed. Shred chicken in the pot after braising.

adaptable.note: Use a certified gluten-free broth or bouillon.
